object_description: Industrial manipulator with 12 semantic parts and separately authored yaw, shoulder, elbow, wrist, and gripper joints.

parts.label: bottom mounting plate
parts.appearance: thick broad square horizontal mounting plate with rounded corners and recessed corner holes, positioned beneath the pedestal

parts.label: lower upright pedestal
parts.appearance: short wide upright cylindrical pedestal with sloping triangular reinforcing ribs around its lower rim, centered on the mounting plate

parts.label: lower rotating turret
parts.appearance: thick horizontal circular drum with a shallow top flange, placed on the pedestal immediately below the shoulder housing

parts.label: left shoulder joint
parts.appearance: large thick cylindrical hinge drum with a circular front cap and curved support cheeks, mounted above the rotating turret

parts.label: rising upper arm link
parts.appearance: long thick tapered rectangular link with rounded edges and a shallow inset broad side panel, rising diagonally to the right from shoulder to elbow

parts.label: upper elbow joint
parts.appearance: large short cylindrical hinge drum with broad circular front cap, positioned at the high bend joining the upper arm and forearm

parts.label: descending forearm link
parts.appearance: thick elongated tapered box-shaped link with beveled sides and an inset face panel, extending downward and right from the upper elbow to the wrist

parts.label: right wrist joint
parts.appearance: short thick cylindrical hinge housing with rounded rear casing and a circular front face, joining the descending forearm to the downward tool flange

parts.label: lower wrist tool flange
parts.appearance: short stepped cylindrical connector descending slightly rightward from the wrist joint into the top of the gripper palm

parts.label: rectangular gripper palm
parts.appearance: compact broad rectangular block with beveled corners and a flat front face, spanning above the two separated gripper fingers

parts.label: left gripper finger
parts.appearance: thick narrow L-shaped articulated finger descending from the left end of the palm, with an inward projecting lower pad facing the other finger

parts.label: right gripper finger
parts.appearance: thick narrow L-shaped articulated finger descending from the right end of the palm, with an inward projecting lower pad mirroring the left finger
